I also think that the VRChat should support the refresh button for the Social tab. The implementation of that button can also reduce unnecessary network traffic. Many of players do not necessarily need the latest information soon when opening Social Tab. So, I think the easy solution is to press the button when you need the latest information.
However, there may be more cool solutions, but the solution must take time. I think there are other important improvements.

comments.mergedPostDetails: I know this would only be a band-aid for the issue, but for a long while now the social menu has been about 70-80% busted for me. It never updates a person's location or whether they have gone offline or vice versa as much anymore, only like maybe 15-20% of the time. The only way I can ever keep my social up-to-date now is by closing and re-launching the app which forces an update for the social menu. Currently, I have to rely on external sources of the API like the VRC website or VRCX to get around on my friend's list and even those have been finicky recently because of the API issues. A button would at least help make it so I don't have to rely on using external sources to see friends. Rate-limiting the button to one refresh per sixty seconds so as not to over-burden the network of course. As it stands right now, this is the main and only issue I've been having and I desperately want this one corrected.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Add a 'force refresh' button for the social menu

comments.value:
Let's swap this back to Open. That doesn't mean anything other than "leaving stuff as planned for almost a year seems annoying".
The way we chose to attack this problem is via improving how live data is handled-- in particular, using Friend Sync to update your friends in real time. It actually ends up working fairly well.
Of course, just because something is the New Hotness doesn't mean it is without bugs! We're working on those.
As an aside, there's a definite psychological effect of simply having a "refresh" button available. I know I hit it in my browser even though I don't really need to.
A good idea, even if it might be less needed nowadays.
